text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win race after race and get famous! 
Then my dream of living a fun, rich life 
with my family will come true!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I won't have to wait for discount 
hours, and I can just shop at the 
supermarket normally! Talk about real 
luxury...!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
